from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A person or entity involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="The name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str = Field(description="The role of the party (e.g., Appellant, Respondent, Applicant)")

class Cost(BaseModel):
    """A specific fee or cost mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str = Field(description="The monetary amount, including currency symbol if present")
    payer: str = Field(description="The party or parties required to pay this cost")
    description: str = Field(description="The type of cost (e.g., Court Fee, Expert Fee)")

class RulingClause(BaseModel):
    """A specific clause or summary of the court's decision."""
    text: str = Field(description="The text of the ruling clause or main holding")

class CaseMetadata(BaseModel):
    """High-level metadata about the case."""
    case_number: str = Field(description="The official case number cited in the document")
    court: str = Field(description="The name of the court issuing the judgment")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The nature of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific legal dispute or cause")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """The structured extraction for a single document."""
    parties: list[Party]
    costs: list[Cost]
    rulings: list[RulingClause]
    case_metadata: list[CaseMetadata]
